title: FridgeLuck ingredient identity map (legacy to canonical)
description: Maps the 50 legacy data.json ingredient ids onto the canonical vocabulary (USDA FDC ids). Authored in data/recipes/legacy-ingredient-map.json by the pipeline packet; unknowns are stated, never invented.

legacy_name.description: The name as stored in data.json, underscores preserved. Example: olive_oil

key.description: Canonical vocabulary key assigned by the pipeline. Example: olive_oil

fdc_id.description: The resolved FDC id, or null while unresolved. Example: 171413

status.description: resolved: unique exact match on name or alias in the bundled 800-row catalog. proposed: single best candidate by rule, needs pipeline confirmation against full FDC. unresolved: no acceptable candidate; pipeline imports from full FDC (CC0).

examples: unique display-name prefix match on generic qualifier

candidates.description: All plausible fdc_ids considered, for audit. Empty only when none existed.
